# Source provenance and integration choices

Inflex modifications are AGPL-3.0-only. Original notices and licenses remain applicable to their source. Dependencies are resolved by the root, media, capability and desktop SwiftPM lockfiles.

| Project                                                         | Pin                                                           | Use and overlap decision                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| TrueForge                                                       | `f5427d9116f1ade2c7ec2dc0172e66894a406204`                    | Runtime foundation. Retains its session loop, event store, tool policy, permissions, cancellation and UI. Inflex does not run a second orchestration engine. Original package names preserve compatibility.                                   |
| Cairn                                                           | Source commit recorded in `sources.json`                      | AGPL-derived goal protocol and phase guidance adapted into TrueForge capabilities. Standalone Python dispatcher, worker leases and a second service are omitted.                                                                              |
| Hindsight                                                       | `@vectorize-io/hindsight-all@1.1.0`, `hindsight-embed==1.1.0` | Dedicated memory service and local Postgres lifecycle. Uses the runtime's account owner and inference queue instead of an independent OAuth credential store. OAuth request semantics also follow its public ChatGPT provider implementation. |
| Framefields                                                     | `framefields@2.4.0`                                           | Native composition, vision, tracking, masks and codecs. Its existing libraries supply media functionality; hosted AI generation is not required.                                                                                              |
| open-computer-use                                               | `open-computer-use@1.1.2`                                     | Uses the upstream native implementation through a shared MCP ToolSource. Separate app/agent loops are not embedded.                                                                                                                           |
| [MarkdownUI](https://github.com/gonzalezreal/swift-markdown-ui) | `2.4.1`, commit `5f613358148239d0292c0cef674a3c2314737f9e`    | MIT native SwiftUI Markdown rendering, including code, tables, links and images; replaces desktop browser rendering. NetworkImage and swift-cmark transitive revisions are locked in `desktop/Package.resolved`.                              |
| Playwright MCP                                                  | `@playwright/mcp@0.0.83`                                      | Browser operations through the same MCP SDK and permission pipeline.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Anthropic Sandbox Runtime                                       | `0.0.77`                                                      | Existing platform sandbox reused for native command execution. No custom replacement sandbox.                                                                                                                                                 |
| FFmpeg, Git, ripgrep                                            | Device executables                                            | Media decode/measurements, version control and search. Versions are reported by device diagnostics.                                                                                                                                           |
| whisper.cpp, Piper, stable-diffusion.cpp, MarkItDown            | Device executables and model files                            | Optional local transcription, speech, images and document extraction. Configure compatible releases explicitly; they are not bundled or claimed installed by the runtime.                                                                     |

Cairn's original prompts are adapted for the shared tool/event loop and evidence-oriented engineering. Source refusal instructions and worker claim/lease machinery are not imported. Native CAD editing is excluded; CAD operations are supplied only by connected MCP servers.

Original MIT and Apache notices for the imported foundation are preserved here, including package-specific licenses. Framefields is Apache-2.0; Cairn is AGPL-3.0. Consult each optional engine's distribution and model license before bundling it.
